title: Super VRUN (SNES, native: C + 65816 assembly on PVSnesLib)
description: The current SNES project: a native Super Nintendo port of VRUN overhauled toward the original CTW game (wall art, shadows, colour math, HDMA, SPC700 music, two-player mode). 2 MB LoROM, FastROM. Built with PVSnesLib 4.6.0 (816-tcc, wla-65816, wlalink) and the SNESMOD driver, assets generated by Python scripts.

toolchain: PVSnesLib 4.6.0 shipped in SuperVRUN/snes-stub/toolchain/pvsneslib (816-tcc, 816-opt, wla-65816, wlalink, gfx4snes, smconv)
Mesen 2 shipped in SuperVRUN/tools/Mesen2 (its own headless test runner; not needed by BrokenDev)

steps.name: build
steps.note: tools/srccheck.py lints first and fails the build on any violation; a good build ends with 'ramcheck: ... OK' and 'Build finished'. Deterministic: the same commit gives the same md5.

reference.note: The rebuilt ROM is byte-identical to the ROM the user plays (desktop/SuperVRUN_bglab.smc in the archive).

run.note: Title: NEW GAME 1P/2P, CONTINUE, OPTIONS. Start begins; the story sequence can be skipped with Start; Y shoots (classic scheme).

compare.why: scripted input reached the game: the same frame number looks different with and without input

oracle.why: Mesen 2.1.1 from the SuperVRUN package (a private deterministic copy: no frame skipping, zeroed RAM, empty saves) against the BrokenNes SNES cores: the picture after N frames must match pixel for pixel within one colour level (Mesen expands 5-bit channels as (x<<3)|(x>>2), BrokenNes as x*255/31). Mesen's capture API lags by an unknown number of frames and its input is polled after its end-of-frame event, so each frame may match at its own offset (0 to 5) and the input is shifted by inputShift frames; both are recorded.

compat.what: Super VRUN on other SNES emulators, its state read through the WLA-DX symbols (supervrun.sym): cur_state_seen is the last state whose entry ran (0 title, 8 story, 1 game: include/game_states.h), snes_vblank_count the PVSnesLib frame counter (its low byte).

scenarios.what: power-on, the title, Start (story), Start (skip the story), verify's play script

checks.what: the title runs (the vblank counter ticks)
the title looks like BrokenNes' title
Start skips the story into gameplay (cur_state_seen STATE_GAME = 1)
the scripted play stays in the game
the game keeps running to the end (the vblank counter keeps ticking)
gameplay is drawn at the end

knownIssues: Per the project's own retrospective: the S-CPU HDMA/DMA freeze and the INIDISP erratum are real-console behaviours that Mesen (and BrokenNes) do not emulate; the project keeps DMAs out of lines with HDMA live by rule.
Baseline has no frame-time slack by design: rare frames end around scanline 234 to 261 of 262. The game's own HUD shows a LAG counter; it should stay at 0.
Parked items are listed at the end of dev_retrospective.md in the archive.
